notes.title: Minor Performance Optimization
notes.content: [h1][b][u]Optimization Update[/u][/b][/h1][h3]Visual Souls and Sinners[/h3][p] Thank you for all the feedback on performance. We know Souls and Sinners can take up a significant amount of load during gameplay, and we want to make your experience smoother. With this update, the number of Souls and Sinners you see on the map now scales with your graphic settings. This change is purely visual and does not affect the actual Souls or Sinners you receive at the end of a stage or at the end of the game.[/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="149,269,"][tr][th colwidth="149"][p]Graphic Setting[/p][/th][th colwidth="269"][p]Visual Souls on Map[/p][/th][th][p]Visual Sinners on Map[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p]Low[/p][/td][td colwidth="269"][p]No Souls seen[/p][/td][td][p]No Sinners seen[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p]Medium[/p][/td][td colwidth="269"][p]1 Soul shown for every 4 spawned[/p][/td][td][p]1 Sinner shown for every 4 spawned[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p]High[/p][/td][td colwidth="269"][p]1 Soul shown for every 2 spawned[/p][/td][td][p]1 Sinner shown for every 2 spawned[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p]Epic[/p][/td][td colwidth="269"][p]1 Soul shown for every 2 spawned[/p][/td][td][p]1 to 1[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p]Cinematic[/p][/td][td colwidth="269"][p]1 to 1[/p][/td][td][p]1 to 1[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]This adjustment was fast tracked because of your feedback. In the future, you will have more freedom to decide how many Souls and Sinners are shown on the map. Please keep sharing your thoughts. Every bit of feedback helps us make The HELL better for everyone.[/p]

tags.feature: With this update, the number of Souls and Sinners you see on the map now scales with your graphic settings.

notes.title: Update 5.5.0: New Notifications System, Tribute Visuals Updated and more
notes.content: [h1]This update brings new tools and refinements to your journey through Mission 1[/h1][p][/p][h2]List of Updates 5.5.0 Brings:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Notifications System[/b] - The first iteration is here to keep you on top of resources, Sinners, and events in your domain.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tribute Visuals[/b] - Brand new look to the Tribute objective panel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Souls Movement[/b] - Refining the movement of the Souls to consume less processing and improve game performance through the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional Improvements[/b] - General fixes and inconsistencies fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Share Your Feedback[/h2][p]Join the discussion on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3733920/discussions/"]Steam Discussions[/url] or [url="https://discord.gg/j79qjsSJBQ"]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts as we continue refining the experience.[/p]

tags.feature: [b]Notifications System[/b] - The first iteration is here to keep you on top of resources, Sinners, and events in your domain.
[b]Tribute Visuals[/b] - Brand new look to the Tribute objective panel.
[b]New Souls Movement[/b] - Refining the movement of the Souls to consume less processing and improve game performance through the game.

notes.content: [h3][b]We have just released the latest updates for our game. [/b][/h3][h3][/h3][h3][b]The changes this time include;[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]- Disconnected Blood Path but the structures would function as normal [/p][p]- Media missing within the tutorial screens [/p][p]- Tutorial interactions issues if proceed too fast [/p][p]- Animation fixes on the new Decree layout [/p][p]- Added some fixes for Decrees affecting the Babel of Lies cost [/p][p]- Addressed typos & inconsistencies [/p][p]- Fixed Altar's production rate [/p][p]- Destroyed Cauldrons would block the construction of Blood Paths [/p][p]- Tweaked "Hustle and Bustle" animations [/p][p]- Fixed voiceover timings [/p]

notes.title: Tutorial Update Incoming!
notes.content:
[p]We know it’s been a while since our last update, and you might be wondering what we’ve been working on behind the scenes. Well… we’ve been quietly brewing something important.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to finally share that the [b]Tutorial[/b] is on the way, and you’ll be able to play it [b]very soon[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]No more [i]“Why why why?”[/i] or [i]“How how how?”[/i][/p][p]
We’ve built a brand-new guided experience that walks you through the core mechanics, helping you get a much better grip on how to survive and thrive in [b]The HELL[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning, we’re getting closer to our next big milestone, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/011da4146d08bb34ca9846a7c0b2c21c2d2b02fc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/ec04f2915a318b5c6281b345166de91a70793ae2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/e8bc4a6d21622a09820cd636e7d6391ae603b092.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/8c22d28d097abe18f7349e8732337acb31271e3d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/6c705259c4a171cb767e12662922025c34648d58.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/620b69f9a03832b6bd1ea63ae9421349bab1b883.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us, and stay tuned![/p]
